combat_history.event: Japan's National Security Strategy committed to a counterstrike capability built around the Type 12 ER and other stand-off weapons.
combat_history.significance: Marked Japan's historic shift toward long-range strike.

modernization.description: Extended-range, multi-domain variants procured in quantity and distributed across the Nansei Islands.
modernization.impact: Turns a coastal weapon into a first-island-chain stand-off strike force.

vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerable to modern shipboard and area air defence.
vulnerabilities.context: Needs saturation and stand-off range to be effective.

vulnerabilities.description: Long-range shots require off-board ISR and targeting.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Distributed coastal batteries across Japan's island chain for anti-ship denial; ER variants for stand-off strike.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: JGSDF surface-to-ship missile regiments; future ship and air carriage.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: China's coastal anti-ship missile is supersonic; the Type 12 trades speed for range and is being extended for counterstrike.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: The coastal missile duel across the first island chain.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: Japan is also buying Tomahawks for counterstrike; the Type 12 ER is the indigenous parallel.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: How Japan is building a counterstrike force.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: A comparable stealthy subsonic anti-ship missile widely adopted by U.S. allies.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: The new generation of Western anti-ship missiles.

doctrine.role: Coastal anti-ship missile evolving into a long-range stand-off and counterstrike weapon.
doctrine.employment: Distributed island batteries deny sea lanes; extended-range variants strike ships and land targets at distance.
doctrine.design_philosophy: From coastal denial to active counterstrike — range growth on a proven airframe.
doctrine.threat_context: Helps close the first island chain to hostile shipping and embodies Japan's shift to active deterrence.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against China's YJ-12B, allied Tomahawk buys and the Norwegian NSM.
